# Shree Ji Stone Murty

Shree Ji Stone Murty is a master artisan shop producing premium makrana marble god statues, intricately carved pink stone temples, fountains, and exclusive home decor.

## Offerings
- Marble Statues (Ganesh Ji, Shiv Ji, Radha-Krishna, Parvati Mataji, etc.)
- Marble Temples and Jali
- Stone Fountains
- Marble Benches and Tulsi Pots
